4. Discussion and Possible Action to Approve Ordinance 2026-08 Submitting
to the Registered Electors of the Town of Lake City, a Ballot Question to
Consider Changing the Town of Lake City Regular Municipal Election
from April to November in Even Numbered Years at the November 2026
General Statewide Election Coordinated by Hinsdale County. Motion to
 approve made by Trustee Whinnery and seconded by Trustee Bruce.
Motion passed with all voting yes, in a roll call vote.

5. Discussion and Possible Action to Approve Resolution 2026-09 Submitting
to the Registered Electors of the Town of Lake City a Ballot Question to
Consider Changing the Number of Trustees on the Town of Lake City
Board of Trustees Should Be Reduced from Six to Four at the November
2026 General Statewide Election Coordinated by Hinsdale County. Motion
to approve made by Trustee Whinnery and Seconded by Trustee
Trivisonno. Motion passed with all voting yes, except Trustees Linsey and
Woods, in a roll call vote.
